affected_analysis: Absolute HDL levels, sex contrast, low-HDL prevalence
evidence_status: Usable marginal U.S. moments; assumption-dependent conditional bridge
consequence: Direct Taiwan intercept transport would differ materially from available U.S. summaries.
next_action: Independent review of MIDUS extraction and calibration; consider a comparable U.S. source if an attainable lead appears.
resolution: Retrieved MIDUS and used its sex-specific mean/SD; no population weights or exact joint distribution available.

affected_analysis: BMI-adjusted regressions, nonlinear contrasts and sex-by-BMI interaction
evidence_status: Within-sex category means usable; continuous slope and extrapolation are bridges
consequence: Different representative BMI assumptions change slope; categories do not identify extreme-obesity behavior.
next_action: Review may motivate a source with continuous BMI slope or category BMI means; UK supplement lead was checked but unsupported.
resolution: Selected log-linear BMI mean using two category ratios, checked the unused categories, and retained explicit extrapolation limitation.

affected_analysis: Age association, age-by-sex and age-by-BMI analyses, 20-29 and 71-79 subgroup comparisons
evidence_status: Adjusted mixed-sex age contrasts, missing sex-specific age estimates and young/old support
consequence: Endpoint holding and common age profile may miss age-specific sex differences or cohort effects.
next_action: Use remaining budget after review for an attainable primary-study lead reporting age-by-sex HDL distributions.
resolution: Initial model uses modest source-derived age pattern; no claim that unreported interactions are absent.

affected_analysis: Low-HDL classification, upper-tail quantiles, heteroskedasticity-sensitive analyses
evidence_status: Marginal sex SDs usable; residual distribution and covariate-specific log scale unreported
consequence: Identical mean/variance can produce different low and high tail probabilities.
next_action: Focused gamma-versus-lognormal sensitivity with identical conditional moments; seek quantiles or low-HDL frequencies if review supplies an attainable source lead.
resolution: Variance decomposition and actual gamma/lognormal countermodel calculations completed; family and scale law remain assumptions.

component: Source predictor distribution and omitted factors
affected_analysis: Conditional calibration and transport of BMI/age associations
evidence_status: Cell counts and marginal predictor moments available; covariance and joint source law missing
consequence: Moment closure can match reported means/SDs while misallocating residual versus predictor variation; omitted disease/race effects need not transport.
next_action: Check sensitivity to source covariance or challenge closure at review; do not construct source microdata as if observed.
resolution: Exact source operator cannot be computed. Independent within-cell normal moment closure is declared and used only as a calibration bridge.

evidence_status: Source fasting and laboratory context available; assay-equivalence data missing
consequence: Fasting, serum/plasma and assay differences may shift location/spread; biobank and biomarker participation may select different covariate-conditioned distributions.
next_action: Retain no estimated assay offset; reassess if review identifies concrete assay calibration evidence.
resolution: No numerical adjustment is identifiable from accessed sources. Difference is kept as a limitation, not absorbed as claimed precision.

component: Evidence uncertainty versus individual residual variation
affected_analysis: Any inferential confidence interval and repeated-draw interpretation
evidence_status: Sampling SEs for some category means but no full parameter covariance or transport uncertainty
consequence: Repeated synthetic draws cannot represent model uncertainty or add independent biomedical evidence.
next_action: Retain fixed auditable model and separately report finite countermodel results, not a calibrated uncertainty interval.
resolution: No arbitrary confidence weighting or transport-variance inflation; only individual residual randomness is sampled.
